title: Invertibility of the canonical derived geometric evaluation mate
statement:
For a fixed GeometryOrdinary realization and target K-injective resolution instances, the right mate of the canonical localized inverse-image/evaluation square under the canonical derived geometric adjunctions is invertible at every index n.

The sites, coefficient tower and fixed ordinary realization are as in lem-coef-semilinear-geometric-derived-evaluation. The precise Lean statement, with the ambient parameter context, is:

universe c v r
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
namespace WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)variable
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)variable (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)
  [∀ n : ℕ, Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' (O.coefficients n))]
  [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions
    (Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)]
theorem geometricEvaluationMate_isIso [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (mateEquiv O.ordinaryAdjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
      (O.levelAdjunction n).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        ((geometryPullEvaluation.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O) n).inv)).natTrans

proof.text: Transport ordinary singleton extension across strictSystemSequenceEquivalence. The identity-on-sections evaluation transport identifies its right adjoint with the actual sequence-site evaluation. Exactness of the equivalence and systemSingle_preserves give quasi-isomorphism invariance on flat-term K-flat complexes. Apply nonempty_normalizedLeftExtension to obtain its normalized universal derived pair.

Use the ordinary singleton mate isomorphism for these two ordinary singleton adjunctions. The exact-square localization factorization and the ordinary mate-unit equation are the normalized comparison hypotheses. The shared inverseImage_good helper preserves the common flat-term K-flat resolving class. Apply derivedExtensionMate_isIso to get invertibility of the derived singleton mate.
The iterated-mates identity expresses the canonical geometric right mate as the conjugate of that singleton mate under the two composite derived adjunctions. Conjugation preserves isomorphisms.
